summary: CenterPoint Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $1,000,000,000 aggregate gross sales price. The filing registers shares to be sold through multiple managers or via forward sale agreements, with a 1% commission. This is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. The prior ATM program was terminated with $84.9 million unsold. The filing details mechanics of equity distribution and forward sale structure but constitutes routine capital-raising activity with no special-situation event. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
